subject: Tri-cloud checkout MAP & billing path for Caldera Systems
messages:
From: Samuel Ortiz <s.ortiz@caldera.ai>
To: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@caldera.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tri-cloud checkout MAP & billing path for Caldera Systems

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the product demo last week — the team was impressed by the batching and routing capabilities. Procurement asked me to capture a short mutual action plan so we can move a Private Offer across AWS and a GCP Marketplace purchase in parallel.

High level ask: can Redwood provide a single MAP that shows:
- owner and deliverable for each procurement step (legal, finance, SOC2 evidence, PO/POC acceptance)
- expected timelines for AWS Private Offer and GCP Marketplace activation
- invoice/billing routing and GL code guidance for each cloud path

We're aiming to complete signatures and billing onboarding within 3 weeks if possible.

Can you share a MAP draft and a billing flow matrix (who we invoice, what the line item looks like, and any marketplace fees) so I can push this through our finance team? Also, procurement wants the SOC 2 summary and a proposed 30-day acceptance checklist.

Sam
Samuel Ortiz
Procurement Lead, Caldera Systems
samuel.ortiz@caldera.ai

From: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Ortiz <s.ortiz@caldera.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 13:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tri-cloud checkout MAP & billing path for Caldera Systems

Hi Sam — thanks, great to hear the demo resonated. Attached is a first-pass MAP (Caldera_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short billing matrix. The MAP is structured to run both paths in parallel but with sequences for acceptance gating.

Quick summary (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): Legal review & SOC2 snapshot delivered (see SOC2_attestation_summary.pdf) — owner: Redwood Legal (Laura)
- Week 1: Private Offer creation (AWS) & Marketplace listing activation (GCP) — owner: Ben (sales ops)
- Week 2: Finance onboarding & invoice test (sandbox invoice + GL mapping) — owner: Redwood Finance (cc'd)
- Week 3: Acceptance testing and go-live checklist (30-day acceptance criteria included inline) — owner: Caldera QA + Redwood solutions

Billing notes:
- AWS Private Offer: Redwood will upload an invoice to Caldera's billing contact; in most AWS PO flows the marketplace does not interpose billing, so Redwood issues the invoice directly. Suggested GL: 6201 - Cloud AI Services.
- GCP Marketplace: invoice routing will follow GCP billing flow unless Caldera elects direct invoicing. There is typically a 5% marketplace fee per GCP policy — we can provide a net/invoice preview.

Attachments: Caldera_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), SOC2_attestation_summary.pdf, Redwood_MSA_draft_v2.pdf (for redline).

Proposed immediate asks:
1) Can you confirm Caldera's finance contact for billing test? (name + email + GL preference)
2) Are you okay with a 30-day acceptance window documented in the MAP?
3) Would you like us to open parallel Private Offer drafts for AWS and GCP now (we can do AWS first)?

I can schedule a 30-minute cadence call to walk through the MAP later today or tomorrow.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Ortiz <s.ortiz@caldera.ai>, priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jul 2028 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tri-cloud checkout MAP & billing path for Caldera Systems

Sam — adding a couple of operational clarifications from the sales ops side.

1) AWS Private Offer path: we will provision a PO-friendly SKU and can accept a standard PO referencing Redwood invoice numbers. Typical lead time for private-offer entitlements is 48-72 hours after offer creation. If you want a single consolidated invoice across clouds we can do a netting invoice but Caldera's AP will need a vendor code for Redwood — please confirm.

2) GCP Marketplace path: GCP often shows a 'marketplace fee' line item on the customer's invoice. If Caldera prefers direct invoicing we will need to opt-out of marketplace procurement for that sku — implications: longer GCP onboarding ~5 business days.

3) Finance test: we recommend a $0.01 test invoice from Redwood to validate GL and remittance fields. Please provide remittance and EFT details.

Attaching Redwood_MSA_draft_v2.pdf for your legal team to look at. Happy to take a quick legal vs. procurement sync if needed.

-ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: procurement@caldera.ai
To: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 08:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tri-cloud checkout MAP & billing path for Caldera Systems

Priya / Ben — thanks for the draft MAP and MSA. A few procurement items we need clarified before we can route to finance/legal: 

- SOC2: can you provide a notarized attestation or a push link to your SOC2 report (summary attached is helpful but we need the reporting URL or auditor contact).
- GL mapping: Caldera requires a specific GL field populated on Redwood invoices (we will share a sample invoice). Is Redwood able to add an "internal GL code" custom field?
- Acceptance window: procurement prefers a 45-day QA acceptance window for marketplace purchases. Is Redwood willing to extend to 45 days for the GCP path?
- PO numbering: we will issue separate POs for AWS and GCP. Please confirm you can accept two POs on a single account and map them to one Redwood customer ID.

Also copying Liam Chen from our cloud integrator (liam.chen@cloudmarket.io) who will need the billing matrix for GCP Marketplace integration.

On the MSA, legal has two redlines around liability caps and data retention — we'll send formal markups this afternoon.

Thanks,
Caldera Procurement
procurement@caldera.ai

Thanks for the clear list — appreciate the specifics. Quick responses inline and a short, updated MAP action list below. I've also left time for a call tomorrow to finalize redlines.

Responses to your asks: 
- SOC2: we can provide the auditor contact and a secure link to the full report (will send secure link via SSO this afternoon). Attachment: SOC2_attestation_summary.pdf (public summary).
- GL custom field: yes, Redwood invoices can include one custom text field for internal GL mapping — we'll populate it on the test invoice.
- Acceptance window: Redwood is willing to extend GCP acceptance to 45 days for the MAP on this deal; we'll note that in the MAP and MSA redlines.
- Dual POs: we can accept separate AWS & GCP POs and map them to one Redwood customer ID; Ben will coordinate the PO-to-account mapping.

Updated MAP (action items and owners):
- Priya (owner): provide secured SOC2 link & updated MAP spreadsheet (today EOD) — deliverable: Caldera_MAP_v1.xlsx (v1.1)
- Ben (owner): create AWS Private Offer draft & GCP listing request; note estimated entitlements time (48-72 hr).
- Laura (owner): review/redline MSA; return by Thu 11:00 PT.
- Redwood Finance (owner): send $0.01 test invoice with GL field populated; schedule billing test call with Caldera AP (target Fri).
- Caldera (owner): confirm AP contact and share remittance details by Thu EOD.

Next steps:
1) I'll send the secure SOC2 link and the updated MAP (v1.1) by EOD.
2) Can we meet Wed 10:00 PT for 30 minutes to confirm MSA redlines and PO mapping? Please reply with availability.
3) Ben will start the AWS Private Offer draft tomorrow morning; Redwood Finance will prepare the test invoice for Friday.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this over the finish line.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
